title: Which Box Hides the Diamond?
youtube_description:
One of these three boxes is hiding a GIANT diamond — but which one? Watch to find out! Comment below if you got it right! 👇

#Shorts #KidsVideo #GuessingGame #DiamondChallenge #Kidify #FunForKids #BrainTeaser

scenes.narration: One of these boxes is hiding a GIANT diamond!
Is it the red box, the blue box, or the green box? Choose now!
scenes.visual_prompt: red blue green gift boxes row

scenes.narration: Three… two… one — let's open them!
The RED box… is full of rubber ducks! Not the diamond!
scenes.visual_prompt: open red gift box rubber ducks

scenes.narration: The BLUE box… has a giant smelly sock inside! Ewww!
scenes.visual_prompt: open blue box smelly sock funny

scenes.narration: That means the GREEN box has the diamond — and WOW, look at that sparkle!
scenes.visual_prompt: open green gift box sparkling diamond

scenes.narration: Did you get it right? Level two is coming tomorrow — don't miss it!
